evaluation_level: artifact-based methodological reproduction of final-paper equations; source discrepancies and underspecification preclude exact numerical replication claim
datasets: Full official FAR-Trans-derived RURA release,all16slices,all29090 released users
upstream: Frozen released row order verified score_blend nonincreasing; preserve input order for ties
profile: Use already-scaled profiles_riskmap_cat gamma_or_eta as rho and B; preserve disclosed risk-order inconsistency; no double category scaling

proposed.sigma2: released pre-slice market_stats; missing slice median
proposed.solver: 64-step KKT water-filling bisection,exact published quadratic program up to numeric tolerance

cm1.detail_limit: Paper describes probability-weighted Sharpe,without formula,clipping or risk-free rate; assume zero risk-free rate. With nonnegative released scores,renormalization preserves order.

cm2.solver: KKT water-filling; exact optimum rather than unspecified finite projected iterations
cm2.detail_limit: Original projected-step count,tolerance and exact coefficient implementation not released.

cm3.solver: 64-step monotone KKT threshold for diagonal GaussianCVaR
cm3.detail_limit: Standard Gaussian-loss CVaR interpretation; paper gives no explicit baseline equation or iteration settings. Positive B multiplies objective and does not change weights; no unsupported extra rho penalty introduced.

numerics.centering: Center linear scores per row for numerical stability of constrained QP; enforce CM2 unit budget
numerics.RURA_variance: Native nonnegative released variance; quadratic diversification makes d strictly positive

labels: First transaction per user/asset in half-open test interval is BUY,and net quantity held before test_start<=0; globally stable date sort. All new labels count in nDCG ideal denominator. Construction-held assets excluded from candidates.

roi.weights: Uniform1/10 on displayed slate; learned weights induce ranking only
roi.price_endpoint_rule: Per asset:first/last positive observed close strictly inside half-open test interval; store dates/gaps. Interpretation frozen before any performance. Original release exact calendar-date equality differs.

utility: Mean(-expm1(-rho*score_blend)) over displayed10; Table2 units1e-4; no B in Eq7
aggregation: User-weighted all user-slices,plus5risk groups; all variants retained
selection: None on test. All13predeclared methods reported; no best variant selected. Published data/table already inspected,so retrospective.
validation: Independent SLSQP objective checks for RURA,CM2 and CM3 on8real profiles each first/last slice
Exact all13variant full-user deterministic rerun first/last slice
Every equal-slate utility <= frozen top-mu upper bound

market_neutral_nocost.reason: No dividends/coupons/verified total-return prices; unavailable upstream/profile point-in-time provenance; no daily NAV inference fabricated.

required_original_vs_optional: All original Table1/2 methods and Figure1 sensitivity domain; release-only UF/CRRA/covariance experiments remain optional/unexecuted.
